feed.title: NPR Topics: Home Page Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: Here's how some key demographic groups voted in the midterms
entry.summary: These charts show how various demographic groups voted in the midterm election. The data comes from a poll of tens of thousands of voters, conducted by the firm SSRS for a number of news outlets.

entry.title: Former Arkansas governor says Democrats' gains are 'more significant than ever anticipated'
entry.summary: NPR's Scott Detrow speaks with former Arkansas Gov. Asa Hutchinson about Democratic victories in states typically considered Republican strongholds.

entry.title: Democrats win full control of Congress, ushering in a new era of divided government
entry.summary: The victories in the House and Senate return Democrats to full control of Congress for the first time since 2023 and deepens the level of expected friction between them and President Trump.

entry.title: Democrat Josh Turek wins the Senate seat in Iowa
entry.summary: Democrat Josh Turek has defeated Sen. Ashley Hinson in Iowa, according to a race call by the Associated Press.

entry.title: On a historic night for democratic socialists, Mamdani says midterms show power of working-class voters
entry.summary: The New York mayor tells NPR's Juana Summers that newly elected democratic socialists need to seize this moment and show voters what politics can deliver.

entry.title: Democrat David Crowley will be Wisconsin's first Black governor
entry.summary: Democrat David Crowley defeated Republican Congressman Tom Tiffany in a campaign that focused on "lowering costs for working families" and bringing more jobs to Wisconsin.

entry.title: Missourians reject ballot proposal that would have re-imposed an abortion ban
entry.summary: Missouri voters defeated a measure that would have banned abortion just two years after voters legalized abortion in another vote. Voters in Missouri legalized abortion two years ago but this time the abortion ban was coupled with a ban on transgender treatment for minors. Opponents said it was misleading.

entry.title: Democrat Gina Hinojosa wins race for Texas governor, ousting Greg Abbott
entry.summary: Hinojosa, an Austin state representative, is set to be the state's first Democratic governor since 1995 and will be the state's first Latina governor.

entry.title: Democrat Rob Sand wins Iowa governor's race, ending GOP control of the office
entry.summary: Democratic State Auditor Rob Sand stressed affordability and often talked about how his Christian faith guides him.

entry.title: James Talarico's Senate win breaks GOP's three-decade grip on statewide offices in Texas
entry.summary: Talarico defeated Republican state Attorney General Ken Paxton, a close ally of President Trump.
